title: Transfer | Menu Board Price Ranking
goal: OCR a folder of cafe menu board photos, extract each listed item name and price, and write a Markdown report containing the cheapest item per board and the overall median price.
skillBenefitRationale: 把 OCR 迁移到远摄菜单板场景，版式更自由、背景更复杂，需要先可靠取字再完成价格统计；任务成立只依赖 image-ocr。
